# Source Intake Guide

Use this page when adding material to `raw/`. The goal is simple: every source should be easy to classify, compile, verify, and cite later.

## Core rule

Keep knowledge content in two places:

- `raw/` for immutable source evidence
- `wiki/` for compiled synthesis and maintained operating pages

Do not create new knowledge folders for notes, decisions, open loops, research leads, claims, projects, or personal observations.

## Recommended frontmatter

```yaml
source_type: external_source | book_note | podcast_or_interview | market_signal | technical_reference | personal_observation | personal_experiment | decision_note | reflection
domain: health | leadership-work | venture | money | canada-policy | ai-software | knowledge-learning | communication | self-meaning | assurance
source_quality: primary | credible_secondary | useful_secondary | useful_practitioner_signal | thin_or_unknown
time_sensitivity: durable_or_unknown | time_sensitive
intended_use: wiki_synthesis | claim_review | personal_synthesis | decision_log | research_lead
needs_verification: true | false
```

## Capture standards

- One source per file.
- Preserve title, URL, author, date, and full useful body when available.
- For personal observations, record date, context, what happened, interpretation, and what it might change.
- For decisions, record options considered and review date.
- For market, health, policy, finance, or product claims, set `needs_verification: true` unless already checked against a current primary source.

## Compile routing

| Source pattern | Default destination |
| --- | --- |
| unresolved question | [Open Loops](/wiki/open-loops) |
| source trail or author/publication lead | [Research Leads](/wiki/research-leads) |
| chosen action or durable decision | [Decision Log](/wiki/decision-log) |
| stale, speculative, contradicted, or public-use claim | [Claim Review](/wiki/claim-review) |
| personal weekly orientation | [Start Here For Me](/wiki/start-here-for-me) |
| durable domain synthesis | the smallest fitting domain or concept page |
